method: Independent read-only source and boundary review; no code changes or new test execution.
verifiedBySourceReview: SPI3 physical pins SCLK9/MOSI10/CS14/DC8/RESET18 agree with official config.h and board initialization. Sharing a pin-routed SPI implementation does not grant modem/audio support.
I2C CST816S@0x15 SDA41/SCL42 exactly match source. Official touch initialization sets rst_gpio_num and int_gpio_num to GPIO_NUM_NC; model returns no touch IRQ and does not reset touch on LCD GPIO18.
Pinned esp_lcd_touch 1.2.1 mirror adjustment is x_max - raw and y_max - raw, so 240 - clamped visible coordinate is correct; subtracting 239 would introduce an off-by-one.

Official touch_feed classifies cover navigation near transformed x=180/200/220 and y about -360, with int16 conversion. Model raw coordinates (60/40/20,600) reflect that source; they remain logical contacts, not measured mechanical calibration.
Power GPIO47 active-low and BOOT0 high-idle are correct; GPIO48 hold/power latch and shutdown timing are explicitly unimplemented.
Shared CST816S state presents only one contact. No fabricated IDs, IRQ pin, ES8311 register device, ML307 transport, SD, or IMU is added by this board.

nonblockingFindings.finding: LEDC duty is observed, but display() uses light != 0 as a gate. Any nonzero duty shows full framebuffer color; proportional optical dimming and fade curves are not simulated.
nonblockingFindings.recommendation: Describe this as source-backed PWM duty observation and backlight on/off gating; do not claim brightness curve or fade validation unless implemented.

nonblockingFindings.finding: The shared panel tracks inversion and MADCTL BGR registers but the framebuffer path copies raw RGB565; new-board optical color calibration/inversion effects are not verified.
nonblockingFindings.recommendation: Keep scope at RGB565 command/window/reset/sleep pixel transport and source pin mapping, and list optical inversion/color calibration as unverified.

nonblockingFindings.finding: Upstream virtual-nav band includes y <= 12. Visible contacts in that band near x=180/200/220 can be classified as navigation by official firmware; the emulator deliberately preserves upstream geometry.
nonblockingFindings.recommendation: Do not apply an undocumented frontend coordinate correction. Calibrate only with hardware/official revised mapping.

runtimeValidation: Existing authored diagnostic tests were inspected; no claim of factory firmware execution or physical hardware validation.
